title: Optimal Stochastic Bilevel Optimization with First-Order Oracles
abstract: arXiv:2610.01843v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study nonconvex--strongly-convex bilevel optimization under a stochastic first-order oracle. We introduce MRT-FD, a single-loop first-order method that simultaneously tracks the upper-level variable, the lower-level solution, and the auxiliary response arising from implicit differentiation of the hyperobjective. MRT-FD performs one update of each variable per iteration and approximates the second-order derivative actions using order-$p$ finite differences. For any fixed finite smoothness order $p\ge1$ in the lower-level variable, MRT-FD finds an $\varepsilon$-stationary point using $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-4-2/p})$ stochastic gradient queries. We also prove a matching $\Omega(\varepsilon^{-4-2/p})$ oracle lower bound. The lower-bound construction starts from a hard nonconvex minimization chain with a stronger stochastic oracle, and lifts it to a bilevel problem through a sinusoidal coupling with a scalar lower-level variable. translated_title: 基于一阶预言机的最优随机双层优化
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在随机一阶预言机下的非凸-强凸双层优化问题。我们提出了MRT-FD，这是一种单循环一阶方法，可同时跟踪上层变量、下层解以及由超目标函数隐式微分产生的辅助响应。MRT-FD在每次迭代中对每个变量执行一次更新，并使用p阶有限差分来近似二阶导数作用。对于下层变量中任意固定的有限光滑阶p≥1，MRT-FD使用O(ε^{-4-2/p})次随机梯度查询即可找到一个ε-稳定点。我们还证明了与之匹配的Ω(ε^{-4-2/p})预言机下界。该下界构造从一个具有更强随机预言机的困难非凸最小化链出发，并通过与标量下层变量的正弦耦合将其提升为双层问题。
tldr: 提出了单循环一阶算法MRT-FD，通过p阶有限差分近似二阶导数作用，以匹配上下界的最优O(ε^{-4-2/p})随机梯度复杂度求解非凸-强凸随机双层优化问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes MRT-FD, a single-loop first-order method that approximates second-order derivative actions via order-p finite differences, achieving the optimal O(ε^{-4-2/p}) stochastic gradient complexity with matching upper and lower bounds for nonconvex-strongly-convex stochastic bilevel optimization.
